text: The team decided: “Switch to Render for hosting this release on Friday.”
attack: 真实发布和供应商决定整句置于弯引号中。

text: Approved verbatim: "We will enable the feature for all users next week."
attack: 真实全量开放决定写在直引号内。

text: 旧笔记“边读边转还是一次性批量转换”
attack: 关键迁移决定术语被引号包住。

text: The chosen owner is `the search service` for the event schema.
attack: 架构决定的关键服务名被反引号包住。

text: We agreed to “submit the desktop build to the app store on Friday.”
attack: 商店提交的真实决定只在引号里。

text: The release call was “open the beta to all customers tomorrow.”
attack: 全量开放决定放在引号中。

text: The banner shows “enable the feature for all users tomorrow” as sample copy.
attack: 界面示例文案，不是开放决定。

text: The fixture includes `ship to production Friday` as a parser test string.
attack: 测试字符串，不是发布决定。

text: A support ticket title is “Switch to Render for hosting”.
attack: 工单标题引用供应商措辞。

text: The log message reads “the search service owns the event schema”.
attack: 日志引文描述当前归属。

text: A design mock contains “open to all customers or a beta group”.
attack: 原型文案，不是范围决定。

text: The release guide uses “submit the build to the store” as an example sentence.
attack: 指南中的示例句。

text: CI passed; submit the desktop build to the app store on Friday.
attack: CI 前置条件不应压掉真实商店提交时间。

text: CI 通过后，周五提交商店。
attack: 题目指定的 CI 后真实提交决定。

text: After validation, open the feature to all production users tomorrow.
attack: validate 前置条件后仍有明确全量开放计划。

text: The nightly pipeline passes; ship version 4.2 to production Monday.
attack: nightly 流程完成后安排生产发布。

text: Integration tests are green, so push the new release to production tonight.
attack: 测试通过后有真实生产发布安排。

text: Validate signing first, then upload the release build to the App Store Friday.
attack: 签名校验前置条件后有真实商店发布决定。

text: The CI job uploads a mock build to TestFlight to check signing.
attack: 测试管线上传假包。

text: Nightly validation copies a fixture build to the app store sandbox.
attack: 夜间验证拷贝夹具到沙盒。

text: The integration test validates a dummy release package; it never reaches users.
attack: 集成测试验证假包，无实际发布。

text: CI checks whether the release metadata can be parsed.
attack: CI 检查元数据，不安排发布。

text: The nightly report lists the builds that were already shipped.
attack: nightly 汇报已完成的版本。

text: Validation is a test stage; no store upload is planned.
attack: 只说明验证阶段且明确没有提交计划。

text: We should switch to Render.
attack: Render 虽无用途补语，但语境是明确供应商切换决定。

text: Adopt Segment for the new product.
attack: Segment 作为普通词供应商被直接采纳。

text: Choose Resend.
attack: 直接选择普通词同形供应商。

text: Let’s replace the current provider with Paddle.
attack: 用 Paddle 替换现有供应商。

text: Temporal or Restate for the workflow engine?
attack: 两个供应商对举，未重复说明用途。

text: Let’s go with Stripe.
attack: 直接采用 Stripe，省略服务用途。

text: Use Segment to divide this analytics paragraph into three segments.
attack: Segment 作普通名词，即使同句提及 analytics。

text: Switch to Resend when the editor should send the email again.
attack: Resend 是重新发送指令，同句 email 不代表供应商用途。

text: Adopt Temporal as an adjective in a sentence about workflows.
attack: Temporal 是普通形容词，同句提及 workflows。

text: Use Paddle as the name of a striped payment icon in the mock.
attack: Paddle 是普通词/图标名称，同句提及 payment。

text: Render the hosting page after the preview is ready.
attack: Render 作动词；hosting 是页面内容语境。

text: The glossary uses “Stripe” to describe a striped payment card.
attack: 普通词义说明，不是采用 Stripe。

text: 旧笔记边读边转还是一次性批量转换？
attack: 新增边读边转迁移策略正例。

text: Should the migration convert rows on read or run in one bulk pass?
attack: 按需转换与批处理的真实架构选择。

text: 会话数据由 core 模块还是 bridge 模块持有？
attack: 真实模块所有权选择。

text: Which service should own the event contract going forward?
attack: 真实未来契约归属决策。

text: Should the notification service own delivery receipts?
attack: 明确选择服务边界与数据归属。

text: 新功能开放给所有客户还是部分客户？
attack: 新增全部/部分客户发布范围选择。

text: Should we open this feature to all customers or only a beta cohort?
attack: 英文全体/子集用户开放决策。

text: The search service should own the index data, not the API module.
attack: 明确建议并排除另一种模块归属。

text: The image decoder reads a pixel and converts it immediately, then stores the result.
attack: 描述现有读时转换行为，不讨论迁移取舍。

text: The core service owns the event schema and emits a snapshot on restart.
attack: 陈述现行模块职责，没有归属决策。

text: The cache service owns session records at runtime; the API only reads them.
attack: 运行时事实陈述，不是选择服务归属。

text: Access is open to all customers or a small beta cohort depending on the subscription tier.
attack: 描述权限当前取决于订阅等级，不是发布范围选择。

text: The access report says the feature is enabled for all users in one region and a subset elsewhere.
attack: 区域现状汇报，不是开放范围决策。

text: The import benchmark converts records as they are read; bulk conversion is disabled.
attack: 报告当前实现状态，不是迁移方案选择。

text: During replay, the service held the event data until the batch closed.
attack: 过去发生的运行事实，不是模块归属决策。

text: The service opens access to every customer by default; this is the current policy.
attack: 当前默认权限陈述，不是在安排发布。

text: “Use Segment” for product analytics.
attack: 关键动作和普通词供应商名一同被引号包住。

text: `Switch to Render` for hosting.
attack: 关键选择语句放在反引号内。

text: 性能日志显示，当前版本边读边转，旧版本还是一次性批量转换。
attack: 复盘报告比较两个版本既有实现，不是在选择迁移方式。

text: 当前开放给所有客户还是部分客户由许可证自动决定。
attack: 描述许可证决定的现状范围，不是新的开放排期。

text: Switch to Render for hosting.
attack: 普通词供应商有明确用途上下文时应保留选择。

text: Switch to Resend for email delivery.
attack: 普通词供应商有邮件用途上下文时应保留选择。

text: Adopt Segment for product analytics.
attack: 普通词供应商有分析用途上下文时应保留选择。

text: 基准报告比较边读边转还是一次性批量转换的耗时；当前服务按文件大小决定实现路径。
attack: 性能报告比较现有实现，当前路径由文件大小自动决定，不是新的迁移决策。
